cases.name: stored
cases.note: Stored entries, no extras: the baseline.

cases.name: deflated
cases.note: Every entry deflated (method 8).

cases.name: data-descriptors
cases.note: Flag bit 3: sizes and CRC-32 only in the descriptor and the central directory.

cases.name: local-bit3-nonzero-sizes
cases.note: Flag bit 3 with non-zero, wrong local sizes and CRC-32: the local values are ignored.

cases.name: local-sizes-ignored
cases.note: No flag bit 3, local sizes and CRC-32 disagree with the central directory: still ignored.

cases.name: local-zip64-extra
cases.note: Local headers carry saturated sizes and a ZIP64 extra field; the central sizes are not saturated.

cases.name: zip64-small
cases.note: ZIP64 structures on a small archive: saturated central fields and extra fields, ZIP64 end records.

cases.name: zip64-end-records-unsaturated
cases.note: ZIP64 end records present although the ordinary record is not saturated (and agrees).

cases.name: unknown-extra-fields-and-comment
cases.note: Unknown extra fields and an archive comment are ignored.

cases.name: unlisted-noise
cases.note: Unlisted entries, including an unlisted UUID-named file once and one with an unknown flag and method, are ignored.

cases.name: entry-order
cases.note: archive.json first and the database last: the order is not part of the contract.

cases.name: no-images
cases.note: An empty attachments map and no image entries.

cases.name: zero-length-stored
cases.note: A zero-length listed entry, stored.

cases.name: zero-length-deflated
cases.note: A zero-length listed entry as the two-byte empty deflate stream.

cases.name: local-extra-length-differs
cases.note: The local extra field is longer or shorter than the central one: the data starts after the local lengths.

cases.name: names-that-only-look-like-profile-names
cases.note: Names that differ from a profile name by case, a backslash, '..' or NUL are just unlisted names.

cases.name: deflate-about-6x
cases.note: A deflated database that expands about 6 times: below the cap of 8.

cases.name: deflate-exactly-8x
cases.note: Uncompressed size equals 8 times the compressed size: allowed.

cases.name: manifest-unknown-members
cases.note: Unknown members of the manifest are ignored.

cases.name: header-valid
cases.note: A header within the envelope bounds: salt of 16 bytes, 100,000 iterations, recovery format 1.

cases.name: random-bytes
cases.note: Not a ZIP file at all.

cases.name: truncated
cases.note: The end of the file is cut off: no end record.

cases.name: empty-file
cases.note: Zero bytes.

cases.name: directory-offset-out-of-range
cases.note: The end record points the central directory beyond the file.

cases.name: directory-size-too-large
cases.note: The end record claims a larger central directory than the file holds before it.

cases.name: comment-length-mismatch
cases.note: The comment length in the end record does not reach the end of the file.

cases.name: trailing-bytes-after-end-record
cases.note: Bytes after a complete end record: no end record reaches the end of the file.

cases.name: two-end-records
cases.note: A second, internally consistent end record forged inside the comment: two candidates reach the end of the file.

cases.name: entry-count-too-small
cases.note: The end record counts fewer entries than the central directory holds.

cases.name: entry-count-too-large
cases.note: The end record counts more entries than the central directory holds.

cases.name: nonzero-disk-number
cases.note: The disk number of the end record is 1.

cases.name: nonzero-directory-disk
cases.note: The disk holding the central directory is 1.

cases.name: zip64-and-ordinary-disagree
cases.note: ZIP64 and ordinary end records give different entry counts, and the ordinary one is not saturated.

cases.name: zip64-locator-without-record
cases.note: A ZIP64 locator that points at no ZIP64 end record.

cases.name: saturated-end-without-zip64
cases.note: The end record is saturated but there are no ZIP64 end records.

cases.name: compressed-size-near-2-64
cases.note: A listed entry's compressed size is near 2^64: adding it to the offset overflows.

cases.name: offset-near-2-64
cases.note: A listed entry's local header offset is near 2^64.

cases.name: zip64-saturated-without-extra-value
cases.note: Sizes and offset are saturated but the ZIP64 extra field is empty.

cases.name: zip64-extra-too-short
cases.note: The ZIP64 extra field lacks the offset the saturated field asks for.

cases.name: zip64-duplicate-extra
cases.note: Two ZIP64 extra fields on an entry whose fields are saturated: readers disagree about which one counts.

cases.name: zip64-duplicate-extra-not-needed
cases.note: Two ZIP64 extra fields on an entry with no saturated field: the field is not consulted, so it is ignored like any extra field.

cases.name: central-extra-past-directory
cases.note: A central directory entry whose extra field runs past the end of the directory.

cases.name: central-comment-past-directory
cases.note: A central directory entry whose comment runs past the end of the directory.

cases.name: central-name-past-directory
cases.note: A central directory entry whose name runs past the end of the directory.

cases.name: compressed-size-larger-than-file
cases.note: A listed compressed size larger than the file.

cases.name: duplicate-database
cases.note: Two entries named journal.sqlite.

cases.name: duplicate-header
cases.note: Two entries named archive.json.

cases.name: duplicate-unlisted-uuid
cases.note: Two entries with the same UUID name that the manifest does not list: refused, so readers that keep only listed names cannot disagree.

cases.name: local-name-differs
cases.note: The local header repeats a different name than the central directory.

cases.name: local-method-differs
cases.note: The local header says deflate, the central directory says stored.

cases.name: local-header-signature
cases.note: A listed entry whose offset does not point at a local header.

cases.name: overlapping-listed-entries
cases.note: Two listed entries whose data ranges overlap: the second lies inside the first's data.

cases.name: header-overlaps-listed-entry
cases.note: archive.json lies inside a listed entry's data.

cases.name: data-covers-central-directory
cases.note: A listed entry whose data range reaches over the central directory.

cases.name: encrypted-flag
cases.note: General-purpose flag bit 0 (encrypted) on a listed entry.

cases.name: strong-encryption-flag
cases.note: Flag bit 6 (strong encryption) on a listed entry.

cases.name: method-12
cases.note: Compression method 12 (bzip2) on a listed entry.

cases.name: method-99
cases.note: Method 99 (AES encryption) on a listed entry.

cases.name: central-directory-encryption-flag
cases.note: Flag bit 13 (central directory encryption) on any entry refuses the archive.

cases.name: listed-entry-missing
cases.note: The manifest lists an image that has no entry.

cases.name: size-differs-from-manifest
cases.note: The manifest says a different size than the central directory.

cases.name: stored-size-mismatch
cases.note: A stored entry whose compressed size is not its size.

cases.name: deflate-compressed-size-zero
cases.note: Method 8 with a compressed size of 0.

cases.name: stale-crc
cases.note: The CRC-32 of a listed entry is wrong in the local header and the central directory.

cases.name: sha256-differs
cases.note: The data and its CRC-32 are consistent, but the manifest hash is of other data.

cases.name: deflate-expands-past-declared-size
cases.note: A deflate stream that would produce 800 bytes for a declared size of 60: the reader stops at the declared size.

cases.name: deflate-ends-early
cases.note: A deflate stream that ends after 20 of the 40 declared bytes.

cases.name: deflate-trailing-bytes
cases.note: Bytes after the end of the deflate stream, still inside the compressed size.

cases.name: deflate-just-over-8x
cases.note: Uncompressed size is one byte more than 8 times the compressed size.

cases.name: deflate-highly-compressed
cases.note: A stream that expands 5000 bytes from about 20: well over 8 times.

cases.name: header-larger-than-16-mib
cases.note: archive.json declares more than 16 MiB.

cases.name: central-offset-not-a-local-header
cases.note: The central directory points a listed entry at an offset that holds no local header.

cases.name: manifest-duplicate-member
cases.note: A repeated member name in the manifest.

cases.name: manifest-duplicate-attachment-key
cases.note: The same image key twice.

cases.name: manifest-bytes-float
cases.note: A size written as 70.0.

cases.name: manifest-bytes-exponent
cases.note: A size written as 7e1.

cases.name: manifest-bytes-negative
cases.note: A negative size.

cases.name: manifest-bytes-above-2-53
cases.note: A size above 2^53 - 1.

cases.name: manifest-bytes-leading-zero
cases.note: A size with a leading zero.

cases.name: manifest-key-uppercase
cases.note: An upper-case UUID key.

cases.name: manifest-key-braces
cases.note: A key in braces.

cases.name: manifest-key-no-hyphens
cases.note: A key without hyphens.

cases.name: manifest-key-traversal
cases.note: A key that names a file outside the folder.

cases.name: manifest-key-path
cases.note: A key with a path.

cases.name: manifest-hash-uppercase
cases.note: A hash in upper-case hex.

cases.name: manifest-not-json
cases.note: Text that is not JSON.

cases.name: manifest-depth-32
cases.note: Containers nested 32 deep in all (the manifest object and 31 arrays): the deepest allowed.

cases.name: manifest-depth-33
cases.note: Containers nested 33 deep: one too many.

cases.name: manifest-names-equal-only-by-normalization
cases.note: Unknown members whose names are canonically equivalent (K and the Kelvin sign, composed and decomposed e-acute) but not the same bytes: distinct members, so no repeated name.

cases.name: header-duplicate-recovery
cases.note: A repeated recovery member in archive.json.

cases.name: header-iterations-below-minimum
cases.note: 99,999 iterations: outside the bounds a reader enforces before it asks for a password.

cases.name: header-iterations-above-maximum
cases.note: 2,000,001 iterations.

cases.name: header-salt-15-bytes
cases.note: A salt of 15 bytes.

cases.name: header-recovery-format-3
cases.note: A file archive is always encrypted: recovery format 3 is damage.

cases.name: header-recovery-format-4
cases.note: Recovery format 4 (no password).

cases.name: header-without-archive-version
cases.note: No archiveVersion member: not a file archive.

cases.name: header-archive-version-1
cases.note: archiveVersion 1 is not defined.

cases.name: header-archive-version-float
cases.note: archiveVersion written as 2.0.

cases.name: header-bom
cases.note: A byte order mark in front of the JSON.

cases.name: header-trailing-comma
cases.note: A trailing comma.

cases.name: header-manifest-not-base64
cases.note: The manifest member is not base64.

cases.name: header-member-name-lookalike
cases.note: The wrapped key's member is spelled with a Kelvin sign (U+212A) instead of K: canonically equivalent, but not the member a reader looks for, so recovery has no wrappedKey.

cases.name: header-names-equal-only-by-normalization
cases.note: Unknown members whose names are canonically equivalent but not the same bytes (K and the Kelvin sign, composed and decomposed e-acute): distinct members, ignored.

cases.name: header-depth-32
cases.note: Containers nested 32 deep in all (the header object and 31 arrays): the deepest allowed.

cases.name: header-depth-33
cases.note: Containers nested 33 deep: one too many.

cases.name: header-values-at-limit
cases.note: Exactly 1000 JSON values in all (every object, array, string, number and literal counts one): the most a header may hold.

cases.name: header-values-over-limit
cases.note: 1001 JSON values: one too many.

cases.name: header-newer-archive-version
cases.note: archiveVersion 3: a newer archive. Reported as newer, not damaged.

outcomes: accept: every listed entry extracts and matches the manifest. damaged and newer are the message classes of protocol/archive.md (Failures): compare the class, not the reason.
purpose: Archives that exercise the ZIP container layer of protocol/archive.md (the file archive): structure, entry validation, and extraction of the entries a given manifest lists. See README.md in this folder.
